name: gi-income-tax-assessment-appeals
description: Gibraltar income-tax assessment appeal reference covering service dates, written grounds, the 28-day appeal period, late-appeal applications, overpayment claims, statutory representatives and separate collection-postponement rules. Explains Tribunal procedure, assessment increases and the effect of settlement, with a disputed-tax allocation example. Based on the March 2026 Income Tax Act consolidation checked in October 2026. Includes the statutory case-stated route to the Supreme Court and Gibraltar MAP submission guidance, completeness requirements and the distinction between proceedings and collection suspension. Operational filing channels and case-specific procedural directions require further verification; independent legal review is pending.
